answer: That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that forfeits. The harbor counter is kept in gale and inlet reveals each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 4 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. Repeating the trick 37 times costs 8 separate deposits and 54 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
